checks.detail: Page does not pass a whole-page loading gate; workspace and active domain remain mounted. Panels receive isLoading and brief loading suppresses absent readings. Actual skeleton geometry and initial paused/loading presentation are not mounted evidence.
Without returned data the adapter preserves the failure, panel shells remain present and refetch recovery is wired. No network recovery was exercised.
Temperature correctly honors independent positive sample counts. Several speed/distance/charging/cost metrics instead treat empty-population zeroed StatsSummary values as measured readings.
Returned content survives refresh failure; the original query remains with the page-level warning/freshness owner. This pass does not clear the contradictory section status in F03.
Partial-result metadata is not consumed and the content adapter removes the refresh-error predicate required by section brief retained labels.
Paused refresh retains payload and retry ownership, but its shared status copy asserts offline from fetchStatus alone.
No duplicate page picker. Header-owned range is inherited, but precise instants are discarded; available header vehicle scope is not consumed by this fleet query.

Existing declared km/kWh/km/h denominators are restored to base SI before current display converters, so those caller conversions match current endpoint magnitudes. The endpoint itself violates the canonical wire contract. No legacy converter calls were found in the 17-file scan.

Monthly savings retains a signed series; the hero estimate clamps negative savings to zero. The backend daily efficiency omission is separately covered by F07, not assumed to prove a signed chart input contract.
SOC and fixed nominal estimates are labeled as battery health/capacity/degradation; cycles defaults to a fabricated measured zero.
Fullscreen/export and accessible data-column inputs remain wired. Missing efficiency field, mislabeled cost breakdown and name-based radar identities invalidate particular outputs.

172 unique literal t() keys checked against canonical English; zero missing occurrences. Five dynamic quick-link label keys exist. This does not establish translated locale, split-projection or browser RTL behavior.
Server weekday labels bypass localization even though surrounding chart labels use t().

Labeled nav/group, type=button, aria-pressed, focus utilities, decorative icons and normal Links remain. Chart descriptions/data columns are present. Source presence is not keyboard, focus, screen-reader or contrast acceptance.

Full-width/min-w-0 allocation, single-column base chart grids, responsive expansion, scrollable tab navigation and 44px minimum tab targets exist. Overflow, wrapping, fixed chart sizing, pointer reachability and shell-safe-area behavior are unverified.

findings.mechanism: The hook supplies precise rolling and timezone-aware calendar instants, but the page sends only YYYY-MM-DD start/end. The endpoint interprets date-only bounds as full UTC days, losing the selected rolling window and local-day boundaries.
findings.repro: Synthetic review: select 24h at 09:49 America/Los_Angeles, or a custom local day. Follow page arguments into URLSearchParams: the request has calendar dates, not the rolling or local-midnight RFC3339 instants. No browser/API reproduction was executed.
findings.needs: One bounded page-range adoption using startInstant/endInstantExclusive through the already capable start/end hook; keep header ownership and range context accurate.

findings.rule: MDC-026 partial evidence must remain partial
findings.mechanism: HTTP200 explicitly supplies partial_result for per-vehicle query failure or a record cap. FleetAnalytics omits it, useFleetAnalytics returns a successful query, and page/brief trust only sees transport status. Incomplete totals appear as ordinary returned evidence without the known missing-source/cap reason.
findings.repro: Synthetic endpoint scenario: one drive fetch fails, or one vehicle reaches1000 records. Endpoint marks is_partial=true and returns200; inspect existing page consumers: none consume the marker.
findings.needs: One typed fleet partial-metadata adoption with existing nonblocking trust/retry presentation; do not discard retained totals or reinterpret HTTP200 as complete.

findings.rule: MDC-026 retained content and trust are orthogonal
findings.mechanism: The content adapter correctly preserves renderers but sets isError=false. Section briefs receive that adapted query and test isError to distinguish retained evidence. After an idle failed refresh they label the cached metrics Returned evidence, while the page/top brief reports retention.
findings.repro: Synthetic query: data present, isError=true, fetchStatus=idle, isFetching=false. Apply retainFleetContent then the FleetSectionBrief predicates; retained becomes false and Returned evidence wins.
findings.needs: One narrow retained-state handoff to domain briefs without restoring destructive panel error gating.

findings.rule: MDC-033 missing population is not a measured zero
findings.mechanism: computeStats([]) returns an object with count=0 and numeric zeros. Speed/distance and charging power/duration/cost consumers use non-null values or object existence rather than sample count, so unavailable measurements display zero. All missing session prices produce cost stats count0, but the cost panel still renders free-looking values.
findings.repro: Synthetic empty drive/session range, or sessions all lacking price: follow empty statistic arrays into count0 summaries and the corresponding rawValue expressions. Contrast temperature's correct independent count checks.
findings.needs: One bounded sample-count-aware stats projection preserving genuinely sampled zero and valid negative temperatures/currency; do not blanket-hide measured aggregate counts.

findings.mechanism: /analytics enables range and is not excluded from vehicle scope. Its header can show a vehicle picker, but the page/query key/request consume no selected vehicle and the endpoint gets the entire fleet.
findings.repro: Synthetic selection A versus B with identical range: page hook arguments and query key are identical; Fleet still enumerates all vehicles.
findings.needs: One route-scope decision: intentionally fleet-wide Analytics should disable the misleading global vehicle control, or explicitly extend the endpoint and typed hook if scoped analytics is the intended product behavior. Do not pretend adding an unsupported parameter filters data.

findings.rule: MDC-026/033 measurement meaning and unknown cycles
findings.mechanism: Fleet writes current BatteryLevel or historical end_soc directly as health_score, computes capacity from fixed75000Wh and degradation as100-SOC, and never sets CycleCount, so JSON reports0. BatteryTab labels those fields health/capacity/degradation/cycles as measurements. Current-state rows are also appended at now regardless of the requested historical range. This is endpoint semantic debt, not a display-unit conversion defect.
findings.repro: Synthetic healthy vehicle with SOC50: endpoint produces health50, capacity37500Wh, degradation50 and cycles0 without health/cycle observations. A past-date request can still append the now-dated SOC row, which latest-row selection can choose.
findings.needs: One bounded battery response/consumer truthfulness correction: authentic observations or explicit unknown/estimated SOC-derived values, no fixed nominal health claims, no fabricated cycles, and declared time coverage. Keep all battery sections present.

findings.mechanism: daily_trend is built with date/drives/distance only. DrivingTab requires daily efficiency>0; safe(undefined)=0, so every row from the inspected endpoint is filtered out and Efficiency trend is always empty.
findings.repro: Synthetic normal nonempty Fleet daily_trend from this builder: apply the filter; no row survives, regardless of real drive efficiency statistics elsewhere in the response.
findings.needs: One explicit daily efficiency response contract and matching display projection, or truthful unavailable-capability explanation while retaining the section. Do not fabricate efficiency from unrelated charging totals.

findings.rule: Chart title must describe its actual quantity
findings.mechanism: Cost by charger type actually calculates count/sum(count), plots count proportions and formats counts. The endpoint type breakdown has no cost field.
findings.repro: Synthetic two charger types with equal sessions but different monetary costs: this panel produces equal bars and numeric session counts under a cost title.
findings.needs: One truthful existing session-share label or an explicitly supported monetary-by-type endpoint extension. No invented costs.

findings.mechanism: Radar values, data-column keys, dataKey and hidden-series identity use display name rather than vehicle id. Two different ids with the same name overwrite one object property and both series read the last value. A name equal to metric also collides with the axis-label key.
findings.repro: Synthetic ids1/2 both named Test with distances10/20: row.Test is first50 then100; both Radar series and exported columns read100. No real names or vehicles were inspected.
findings.needs: One stable id-backed series key adoption retaining display labels and reconciling existing legend preference IDs deliberately.

findings.mechanism: Math.max(estimated gasoline cost minus actual cost,0) hides a negative estimated saving, while monthly savings preserves negative monetary differences.
findings.repro: Synthetic distance100km and cost30: the hero formula yields12.75-30=-17.25 but sends0 to the currency metric.
findings.needs: One signed estimated-savings presentation or explicit approved loss-aware wording; do not silently replace additional spending with measured zero.

findings.rule: MDC-044 localize labels and time context
findings.mechanism: The endpoint emits Sun/Mon/Tue/etc as day labels; OverviewTab uses them directly in axis/data-table fields. Changing UI locale cannot translate these backend English abbreviations through any existing local projection.
findings.repro: Synthetic non-English locale with the unchanged seven-row endpoint response: XAxis and exported day column still contain server English labels.
findings.needs: One stable weekday identity-to-localized-display projection using existing locale/date formatting; keep chronological day identity and data unchanged.

findings.rule: MDC-045 canonical raw SI on wire/cache
findings.mechanism: Backend derives kilometers, kWh, km/h and minutes from canonical stored values and returns those denominations; the hook caches them unchanged. Frontend type comments accurately declare these legacy derived denominations, and existing meter/Wh reconstructions are consistent with them. Nevertheless the endpoint is not the required canonical wire/cache SI shape.
findings.repro: Synthetic stored distance1000m and energy1000Wh: inspected expressions emit total_distance_km1 and total_energy_kwh1 instead of canonical meter/Wh fields. This is source contract evidence, not observed API traffic.
findings.needs: One explicitly authorized canonical endpoint/DTO/consumer cutover under current SI methodology. Do not change factors under existing field names or add a dual-shape compatibility adapter. Persistent instructions' methodology path was absent; recover its actual authority before a unit-field write.

findings.rule: MDC-026 paused refresh is not proven device offline
findings.mechanism: Any fetchStatus=paused maps to the localized Paused offline badge without an online/device-evidence predicate. This page passes the original query to that shared owner.
findings.repro: Synthetic query with retained data and fetchStatus=paused, browser connectivity unknown: source status resolves paused and its badge copy asserts offline.
findings.needs: One existing shared paused-status wording/evidence correction; preserve retained data and retry, do not turn deferred refresh into an invented server error.

candidates.detail: Speed/distance bucket labels are fixed backend km/h and km ranges without explicit units, unlike user-unit-converted cards. Potential imperial interpretability issue; no mounted axis/tooltip/accessibility reading was inspected. Do not simply relabel unconverted bounds as mph/mi.

Zero/unknown efficiency sorts before positive observed efficiency, and radar area opacity0.15 exceeds the design's8percent area target. Exact product semantics and composed intensity need a bounded followup; neither browser harm nor a physical measurement validity contract was established here.
Resolved false-positive: glow=cyan is the persisted API spelling for a restrained semantic hover border, not a colored shadow/glow. Do not change this prop merely from its name.

Existing layout-reference sub-barrel imports are not category-barrel adoption. Source-only architectural candidate; no cycle, missing export or runtime failure was established and no source rewrite was authorized.

safe() converts missing/invalid numbers to zero before chart projection. These paths can collapse unknown into real zero if partial/null numeric rows arrive. Current declared row numerics are non-null; no actual malformed payload was inspected, so do not call this a reproduced crash.
